title: Waypoint: a recovery-contract checker and mutation-calibration bed for agent and workflow runtimes
description:
Waypoint is a reproducible research artifact and developer tool for checking the crash-recovery semantics of agent and workflow runtimes.

It contains: a deterministic fault-injection calibration bed; machine-checkable recovery contracts (C1-C6, S1-S3, plus log-integrity checks L1) with explicit preconditions, assertions and observation points; a mutation-calibration gate that requires 13 injected violations to be caught with zero false positives on a healthy baseline; a dependency-free CLI and JSON event/ledger format; and adapters/observations for real frameworks on pinned versions.

Contracts that an adapter cannot observe are reported as unobservable rather than silently passing. The release intentionally documents what is not modelled (for example, power-loss semantics and distributed logs).
notes: Public repository: https://github.com/zhaojie-tech/waypoint. DOI assigned: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23470416
